rule.name: MixedTimeUnits
rule.message: Time values in two different units meet here without a conversion: seconds with milliseconds, nanoseconds or minutes, in a +, -, comparison, assignment or argument, so the result is off by a factor such as 1000. Convert once where the value enters (TimeUnit.SECONDS.toMillis(seconds), Duration.ofSeconds(seconds).toMillis() or seconds * 1000) and name the result with its unit; if a name gives the wrong unit, rename it to the real one.
